readiness_evidence: Not ready to offer: no hosted replay against a live Wix site that declares pay-at-service has been run, and the business side was reported ready (merged and green) but not yet generally available when this was written.

Offline: the full test suite passes, including new loopback end-to-end tests for a business that declares the pay-at-service extension (checkout, disclosure shown first, completion with an empty payment, no Link payment) and for one that does not (booking stays direct).

Existing businesses stay compatible: a service paid at the appointment is booked through a checkout only when the business declares the extension; otherwise the direct booking path is unchanged. Paid, deposit and free bookings are untouched.
The saved booking file keeps format 2 and gains no required field; a session saved by 0.7.0 resumes unchanged.
user_summary: Bookings paid at the appointment can now go through the business's checkout, so you get an order record while nothing is charged until you arrive.
